columns: same as step4-sweep/sweep_minute.csv, plus final_shares, final_stock, final_cash (from simulate() f_open/curve; see run_grid_full.py _one2)

engine.description: draft tickround v1 (tick_mode none/primary/nearest, default primary; Claude scope: trail judgments + buy_and_hold rounded)

grid.dedup_rule: draft grid_params(): sell_rule=fixed resets trail_ignite/trail_cap/upper_tp/l2_solo to base; sell_rule=code resets fixed_tp to base; identical Params collapse to one
grid.identity_check: setting tuples identical to step-4 daily sweep_all.csv (1008 unique, 0 only-mine, 0 only-daily)

method.checkpointing: per-ticker chunks of 84 settings, pickled to chunks/ + progress.json; resume skips finished chunks

ranking.row: liq_ (full-period liquidation-deducted Calmar). The draft falls back to liq_ because config_step3.json segment types are 상승/박스/하락, so the 하락·박스 combined (main_) set is empty.
ranking.rules: depletion >= 1 -> excluded; positive CAGR by Calmar; non-positive CAGR after positives by CAGR then MDD; Calmar None -> judgment-deferred regardless of sign
ranking.scope: per ticker across all 1,008 settings (same scope as the staged minute grid)

runtime.interruptions: 5 exec sessions; 4 killed by SIGTERM at ~1.6-2.3h each (runtime session limit); all resumed from chunk pickles, 0 rows lost
